ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:20; dominated by low-intensity dark pixels (>95%) with sparse high-intensity white anomalies (<5%) corresponding to scars and calcifications.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform low-intensity (black) pigmentation across both fluke lobes; high-contrast white features are non-contiguous, consisting of small circular clusters at distal tips and scattered linear streaks across the central and outer lobe areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serration along the entire boundary; includes a distinct, large-scale irregular excision (notch) on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curvature sweeping upward to acute apical points at the distal tips; leading edge exhibits a smooth, symmetrical concave transition toward the peduncle.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular clusters (~10-20 pixel diameter) concentrated at the distal tips and randomly distributed across the ventral surface, indicative of barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, unaligned high-contrast white linear streaks; prominent vertical rake-like markings on the mid-left lobe and shorter horizontal scratches on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular trauma/notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive and unique pattern of intersecting white linear 'rake marks' concentrated on the medial and distal regions of the left lobe surface.
